findings.highlight: the Master at the Ryuudou Temple and us, the intruders
findings.evidenceJa: 柳洞寺に潜むマスターと、その陣地に挑む俺
findings.governingReading: The figurative scale assigns the two possible deaths to the hidden Master and Shirou himself.
findings.explanation: The English replaces Shirou with the whole intruding pair, blurring the mortal opposition Saber has just stated.

findings.highlight: at the end of the winding mountain path
findings.evidenceJa: 緩やかな山道の終わり
findings.governingReading: The temple stands at the end of a gently sloping mountain road.
findings.explanation: The English changes gradient into winding shape.

findings.highlight: This place was an ominous place last time, but it is worse now.
findings.governingReading: Saber says the wind is unfavorable and orders Shirou not to leave her side.
findings.explanation: The English conditionally restores an inactive comparison with a previous visit, adding history and escalation absent from the active Japanese.

findings.highlight: There must be something wrong about it.
findings.evidenceJa: 何か、その監視役とやらに思うところがあるのか
findings.governingReading: Shirou wonders whether Saber has some concern about the supposed familiar.
findings.explanation: The English turns his open reading of her expression into an asserted defect in the familiar.

findings.highlight: There are two reasons the watcher would depart
findings.evidenceJa: 門番を下げた意味は二つ
findings.governingReading: The enemy has deliberately withdrawn the gatekeeper despite knowing of their arrival.
findings.explanation: “Depart” removes the unseen enemy’s agency in pulling the guard back, weakening the trap logic.

findings.highlight: Saber charges forward to grab my hand.
findings.evidenceJa: 地を蹴って俺の腕を掴むセイバー
findings.governingReading: Saber kicks off the ground and actually grabs Shirou’s arm before Rider knocks her away.
findings.explanation: The English changes arm to hand and renders the completed grasp as an attempted purpose.

findings.highlight: There’s no blood left in my body
findings.governingReading: The active Japanese fragments Shirou’s perception around his fingers, cold, darkness, and failing consciousness.
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces that sequence with inactive blood-loss narration absent from the active witness.
